title: Putnami Database Binding
description: The resolved physical connection data a deployer/environment injects into a workload after provisioning, keyed by logical datasource name. Framework adapters convert each datasource's connection into a pgx/postgres.js configuration internally. Bindings carry secrets and must never be written into infra/requirements.json.

databases.description: Resolved datasources, keyed by logical datasource name.

datasourceName.description: Canonical logical datasource identifier: lowercase letters, digits, '-', '_', '.', '/'; 1–64 chars.

engine.description: Database engine. Closed enum; postgres is the only v1 implementation and adding an engine requires a protocol version bump.

schemaName.description: Owning schema / search_path entry; an unquoted SQL identifier. Required for postgres.

database.description: One datasource's resolved binding: engine, schema, and the physical connection.

connection.description: Resolved physical connection. Declares exactly one transport strategy: a self-contained 'dsn'; or a structured TCP connection keyed by 'host'; or a cloud/provider socket keyed by 'instance'. A 'dsn' is self-contained and accepts no structured field. The exactly-one-transport and dsn-self-containment rules are enforced by the strict validator.

dsn.description: Self-contained connection string (e.g. postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db?sslmode=disable). Mutually exclusive with every other field.

database.description: Physical database name (structured or instance strategy).

ssl.description: Request TLS for the structured (TCP) strategy.

instance.description: Cloud/provider instance identifier for the socket strategy (e.g. "project:region:instance" for Cloud SQL).
